ui_bugs.issue: PL tab is hidden unless vehicle.status is 'sold' or 'archived' (VehicleProfile.js line 182). Review request states PLTab should render editable purchase_price + current_value for ACTIVE vehicles (cost centre semantics). Current gating hides pl-tab / pl-total-cost / pl-cost-per-month / pl-cost-per-km / pl-monthly / pl-purchase-price-edit / pl-empty on active vehicles so the entire PL cost-centre UX is unreachable for the common case. Could not test PL testids because active test vehicle didn't show the tab.

action_items: Decide PL tab visibility: if cost centre is intended for active vehicles per Iter 50 spec, remove the status==sold/archived gate at VehicleProfile.js:182. If it's intentional (owner sees P&L only after selling), update the review acceptance criteria — the requested testids cannot exist on active vehicles otherwise.
critical_code_review_comments: PL tab gate (VehicleProfile.js:182) contradicts the Iter 50 cost-centre rewrite. Suggest: always show PL tab; the endpoint already returns net_result=null when not sold, so empty/mid-life states render fine.
FuelTab l/100km calculation formula: uses liters/km*100 for the CURRENT full tank (full[i].liters), correct behavior since consumption between fill i-1 and i is captured by filling to full at i. OK.

PLTab.js uses inline PATCH for purchase_price/current_value — untested here because PL tab was hidden. Ensure PATCH endpoint is /api/vehicles/{id} PUT (already validated for empty-string coercion) not a separate PATCH route.

rca of the issue: PL tab hidden gate — VehicleProfile.js line 182 has explicit `if (tid === 'pl') return vehicle.status === 'sold' || vehicle.status === 'archived'`. This is a leftover from earlier P&L semantics (post-sale summary only). Iter 50 rewrites the endpoint to a cost-centre for active ownership, so the gate should be removed. Fix: replace filter with `.map(...)` unconditionally, or gate a different way (e.g., always show, disable edits when sold).
